0022600191.text: The Knicks visit the Cavaliers for their ninth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 3-4 overall, 1-2 on the road, and eighth in the East, 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, after a win in their most recent game. Cleveland is 4-3 overall and 3-1 at home, second in the Central and fifth in the East, but it lost its most recent game. The Knicks won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 130-93 win in Cleveland on May 25, 2026, and Josh Hart is out with an ankle injury.
